import pandas as pd

# Read the CSV file
df = pd.read_csv('/input/task_75/context/csv/qualifying.csv')

# Filter for raceId=19 and check q2 times
race19_data = df[df['raceId'] == 19]
print(f"Total records for raceId=19: {len(race19_data)}")
print("\nColumns:", race19_data.columns.tolist())
print("\nSample data:")
print(race19_data[['driverId', 'position', 'q1', 'q2', 'q3']].head(10))

# Check q2 column dtype and nulls
print(f"\nq2 dtype: {race19_data['q2'].dtype}")
print(f"q2 null count: {race19_data['q2'].isnull().sum()}")
print(f"q2 non-null count: {(race19_data['q2'].notna() & (race19_data['q2'] != '')).sum()}")

# Find the record with the fastest q2 time
non_null_q2 = race19_data[race19_data['q2'].notna() & (race19_data['q2'] != '')]
print(f"\nRecords with valid q2: {len(non_null_q2)}")

if len(non_null_q2) > 0:
    # Sort by q2 time (ascending = fastest first)
    # Parse the time format "M:SS.mmm" into seconds for comparison
    def parse_time(time_str):
        parts = time_str.split(':')
        minutes = int(parts[0])
        seconds = float(parts[1])
        return minutes * 60 + seconds
    
    non_null_q2['q2_seconds'] = non_null_q2['q2'].apply(parse_time)
    fastest = non_null_q2.loc[non_null_q2['q2_seconds'].idxmin()]
    print(f"\nFastest q2 time: {fastest['q2']} ({fastest['q2_seconds']} seconds)")
    print(f"Driver ID: {fastest['driverId']}")
